_readme: Second own-site map read at Las Positas College (S346, SkyCairn). Read 1 (run 37811253611) found the Program Map Updates pages, which describe the faculty's map PDFs and link none; they link the Pathway Student Success Team pages, not yet read. A web search (2026-10-08) found the Automotive department's guided-pathway PDFs on the college's own host (auto/assets/docs/guided-pathway/), each a Fall and Spring sequence. This read loads one PSST page and prints its map or PDF links, and loads the Automotive A.S. guided pathway PDF.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses.
